# Kleo AI

> Kleo makes complete narrated films from a brief, inside the AI assistant you already use: a treatment, a storyboard, every shot generated as moving footage, one narrator, a 4K 60 fps MP4 you download and publish. Two looks, realistic and animation. A remote MCP server with OAuth.

## Pages
- [Kleo AI — Human Direction. Agent-Made Films.](https://kleooai.com/): Complete narrated films, realistic or animation, made from your AI assistant through MCP. 4K 60 fps, 15 seconds to 5 minutes, English or Italian narration.
- [Kleo AI Pricing — Credit Packs and Video Cost Calculator](https://kleooai.com/pricing/): Kleo credit packs from €5, one-off and in EUR, no subscription. One credit is two seconds of film, 10 credits minimum, realistic or animation at the same price.
- [AI YouTube Video Generator — Narrated Films from a Brief | Kleo](https://kleooai.com/ai-youtube-video-generator/): Make a narrated YouTube video (16:9) or Short (9:16) from a brief with Kleo: realistic or animation look, 4K 60 fps MP4, 15 s to 5 min, from 10 credits.
- [Connect Kleo AI — one address, any assistant](https://kleooai.com/connect/): Add Kleo to Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, OpenCode or Gemini CLI: one MCP address, one Start free button, 7 credits to begin.
- [Create AI Videos with Claude and Kleo — Setup Guide](https://kleooai.com/integrations/claude/): Add Kleo to Claude as a custom connector, ask for a narrated film and get the 4K MP4 link in the same chat: setup steps, a first prompt and troubleshooting.
- [Create AI Videos with ChatGPT and Kleo — Setup Guide](https://kleooai.com/integrations/chatgpt/): Connect Kleo to ChatGPT in Developer mode with OAuth and direct a narrated film from the chat: tested steps, first prompt, production flow, credits, fixes.
- [Kleo MCP documentation — endpoint, OAuth and the tools](https://kleooai.com/video-generation-mcp/): Kleo’s remote MCP server, documented: the Streamable HTTP endpoint, OAuth 2.1 in one button, each kleo tool in the order it runs, the price rule and the output.
- [Kleo AI Video Examples — Tether and Signal Delay](https://kleooai.com/examples/): Two films rendered with Kleo’s realistic look: Tether, 20 seconds in one shot with no words, and the opening minute of Signal Delay, a Voyager 1 documentary.
- [Tether — a 20-second film by Kleo, realistic look](https://kleooai.com/examples/tether/): Tether, a Kleo film in the realistic look: one unbroken 20-second pull-back from an astronaut’s face inside his helmet to the station he is tethered to.
- [Signal Delay — a Kleo documentary opening about Voyager 1](https://kleooai.com/examples/signal-delay/): Watch the first minute of Signal Delay, a Voyager 1 documentary told as mission logs by one narrator and rendered with Kleo’s realistic look at 4K 60 fps.
- [Kleo Film Looks — Realistic and Animation](https://kleooai.com/styles.html): Kleo makes narrated films in two looks: realistic, generated live-action footage, and animation, a 2D animated film. Same workflow, same price, 4K 60 fps.
- [Kleo AI FAQ — Films, Looks, Credits and Rendering](https://kleooai.com/faq/): Answers on Kleo’s narrated films: realistic or animation look, 15 seconds to 5 minutes at 4K 60 fps, credits, packs, a typical 25–35 minute render, cancelling.
- [About Kleo AI — a remote MCP video studio, run by one person](https://kleooai.com/about/): What Kleo AI is and who runs it: a remote MCP server that makes narrated 4K films in two looks from your assistant, the price, the sample films and contact.
- [Terms | Kleo AI](https://kleooai.com/terms.html): Kleo’s terms in plain words: 7 credits to start, a film costs at least 10, the videos are yours, files last 7 days, and no promise that cannot be kept.
- [Privacy | Kleo AI](https://kleooai.com/privacy.html): What Kleo stores, for how long, and who else sees it. An account is a cookie, rendered files are deleted after 7 days, and this site carries no trackers.

## Facts (deployed server, 14 September 2026)

15 seconds to 5 minutes; 16:9 or 9:16; English or Italian narration; realistic or animation look; 4K 60 fps MP4; no background music, no captions, no automatic publishing; a render takes about 25–35 minutes on a rented GPU. 1 credit = 2 seconds of film, rounded up, 10 credits minimum. 7 credits on connecting; packs €5 = 10 credits, €15 = 35, €40 = 100, one-off, no subscription. MCP endpoint: https://mcp.kleooai.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1). Contact: kleooai@gmail.com. Source: https://github.com/tonnooooo/kleo-mcp
